## v1.8.1 — Jellyfin posters, instant status, Taghawsa theme

Your media wall just got real: the Jellyfin stream card now shows actual movie posters with playback controls, media credentials live where every other integration lives, and the dashboard never flashes empty statuses on reload.

### New features

- **Jellyfin now-playing posters** — the stream card shows the movie/episode artwork while someone is watching. Posters are proxied through the AMUD server, so your Jellyfin URL and API key never reach the browser.
- **Playback controls** — admins can pause, resume, or stop the active Jellyfin session right from the dashboard. Controls appear only while something is streaming and hide automatically otherwise.
- **Taghawsa theme** — a new WebGL theme with an animated gradient and mouse ripple effect (38 themes total). Falls back to a static CSS gradient on mobile and reduced-motion setups.
- **Instant status on reload** — last-known app statuses and container CPU/RAM are embedded in the page HTML and hydrated from a local cache, so cards show real values immediately instead of `CHECKING...` and dashes.

### Changes

- **Media integrations moved to Add App** — Jellyfin/Emby and Plex are now configured per app via the Integration dropdown, the same as every other integration. Credentials previously saved in Settings → Integrations are migrated to the matching app card automatically on first start — no action needed.

### Fixes

- **Container start/stop errors** — the opaque `HTTP request failed: client error (SendRequest)` is gone: the agent retries once on stale connections and reports actionable messages (connection refused, missing Docker socket, timeout).
- **Copyable metrics** — selecting or copying text from app card metrics no longer opens the app URL.

### Upgrade

```bash
./update-amud.sh
```

Or pull the latest Docker image: `tradmss/amud-dashboard:latest`  
https://hub.docker.com/r/tradmss/amud-dashboard

**Binaries:** `amud-server`, `amud-agent` (amd64 + arm64), `ui.tar.gz`, and `SHA256SUMS` are attached below.
